definitions.gloss: on hand; available; in one's possession
definitions.explanation: Items, money, or resources that one currently has and can use immediately. Often used as a modifier before nouns.

examples.english: I have no money on hand.

examples.japanese: {手持|ても}ち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{現金|げんきん}→現金：02716_genkin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{足|た}りない→足りる：01209_tariru⟧。
examples.english: I don't have enough cash on hand.

examples.japanese: {手持|ても}ち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{株|かぶ}→株：02592_kabu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{全部|ぜんぶ}→全部：02888_zenbu⟧⟦{売|う}った→売る：00906_uru⟧。
examples.english: I sold all the stocks I was holding.

examples.japanese: {手持|ても}ち{無沙汰|ぶさた}で⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{分|わ}からない→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: I'm at a loose end and don't know what to do with myself.

examples.japanese: {手持|ても}ち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{資料|しりょう}→資料：04166_shiryou⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{足|た}りない→足りる：01209_tariru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{図書館|としょかん}→図書館：00580_toshokan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{調|しら}べる→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧ことにした。
examples.english: The materials I had on hand weren't enough, so I decided to do research at the library.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
- ⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧ - hand
- ⟦{持|も}ち→持つ：00478_motsu⟧ - holding, possession

KEY EXPRESSION:
- {手持|ても}ち{無沙汰|ぶさた} - having nothing to do, at a loose end, idle
This expression describes the uncomfortable feeling of having nothing to do with one's hands/time.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {手持|ても}ち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + [noun] - [noun] on hand, available [noun]
- {手持|ても}ち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{現金|げんきん}→現金：02716_genkin⟧ - cash on hand
- {手持|ても}ち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{資料|しりょう}→資料：04166_shiryou⟧ - available materials
- {手持|ても}ち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{株|かぶ}→株：02592_kabu⟧ - stock holdings

USAGE:
Often used as a no-adjective modifying another noun:
- {手持|ても}ち⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧ - items in one's possession
- {手持|ても}ち⟦{資金|しきん}→資金：09937_shikin⟧ - available funds
- {手持|ても}ち⟦カメラ→カメラ：04417_kamera⟧ - handheld camera

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{在庫|ざいこ}→在庫：04701_zaiko⟧ - inventory, stock
- ⟦{所持|しょじ}→所持：12751_shoji⟧ - possession
- ⟦{保有|ほゆう}→保有：11615_hoyuu⟧ - holding, ownership
- ⟦{手元|てもと}→手元：07605_temoto⟧ - at hand, nearby

REGISTER:
Neutral. Common in everyday conversation and business contexts.
